description: This file defines the Task model class for managing scheduled task records within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods to add new tasks and retrieve the total count of tasks, interacting with the database to perform these operations.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Model class responsible for managing task records in the database within the Setting namespace.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Inserts a new task record into the database with specified data, setting its status to 'pending' and recording timestamps. Returns the ID of the newly created task.

methods.name: getTotalTasks
methods.description: Returns the total number of task records in the database, optionally filtered by code and status.
